entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... Diana? I... I'm hoping you can help. I need to return this VeloBand tracker. I'm just so confused by everything.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... I can't use it now. It's all been too much. We had a family emergency right after the package came. My husband had to be rushed to the hospital.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright. So, to confirm, the device works fine, but you're looking to return it due to a change in your personal circumstances?
Yes, exactly. He needed an emergency surgery, and I've just been... overwhelmed. I completely forgot about this return window thing. I don't really understand how it works. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I completely understand that this would be the last thing on your mind. Let me pull up your account and check our policy for you. I see here the band was delivered 17 days ago. One moment while I review the return eligibility.
Okay, thank you. My son is about to leave for a military deployment and he was saying some companies are really strict.

Alright, I've checked our policy. It looks like you have nothing to worry about. Our records show that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, as long as they're in the original condition.
Oh, 90 days? Really? That's a huge relief.

Yes. Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now. I am sending the prepaid return label to the email address on your account.
Wow. Thank you so much, Diana. After dealing with the whole hospital situation, this is... this is really a big help. Thank you.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could make this one part of your day a bit easier. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was it. Thank you again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better soon.
